pairs.target: yǔ xià dào dìsāngè xiàwǔ , tǎ wéi zhōngyú rènbùchū zìjǐ xǐ guò de nà jiàn shàngyī le .
pairs.english: By the third rainy afternoon, Tavi could barely recognize the shirt he had washed.
pairs.hanzi: 雨下到第三个下午，塔维终于认不出自己洗过的那件上衣了。

pairs.target: tā hé pà wò de liǎngtiáo kùzǐ jǐ zài tóng yìgēn shéng shàng , měicì mō dōu shì liáng de ,
pairs.english: It shared a rope with two pairs of Pavo's trousers; every touch found it cold,
pairs.hanzi: 它和帕沃的两条裤子挤在同一根绳上，每次摸都是凉的，

pairs.target: wén qǐlái xiàng yìjiān guān le hěn jiǔ de guìzi .
pairs.english: and it smelled like a cupboard shut for a very long time.
pairs.hanzi: 闻起来像一间关了很久的柜子。

pairs.target: pà wò shuō zài guà liǎngtiān jiù néng zhǒng mógu .
pairs.english: Pavo said two more days on the line and they could grow mushrooms.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃说再挂两天就能种蘑菇。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ yīfu fān le gè miàn , méi lǐ tā , ná le běnzi qù běi gōngfáng .
pairs.english: Tavi turned the shirt over, ignored him, and took his notebook to the north workshop.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把衣服翻了个面，没理他，拿了本子去北工房。

pairs.target: mǐlā de qiáo zuótiān zǒngsuàn búzài tuōdǎo qiáodūn , jīntiān liǎng rén yuē hǎo gǎi cè dǎng .
pairs.english: Yesterday Mira's bridge had finally stopped pulling its piers over; today they had arranged to adjust the side guide.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉的桥昨天总算不再拖倒桥墩，今天两人约好改侧挡。

pairs.target: tā dào dé zǎo , gōng fánglǐ hái zhǐyǒu yíwèi lái sòng mùliào de kù gōng .
pairs.english: He arrived early. There was only a warehouse worker delivering timber inside.
pairs.hanzi: 他到得早，工房里还只有一位来送木料的库工。

pairs.target: nà rén zhèngzài ménbiān dǒu màozi , yìyǎn rènchū tā , shuō jiù cāngfáng nà zhāng huàtú de zhǐ hái liú zhe .
pairs.english: The man was shaking out his hat by the door; he recognized Tavi at once and said they still had that drawing from the old warehouse.
pairs.hanzi: 那人正在门边抖帽子，一眼认出他，说旧仓房那张画图的纸还留着。

pairs.target: " zhèhuí shuǐ wǎng xīn kāi de gōu zǒu le .
pairs.english: “This time the water went down the new ditch.
pairs.hanzi: “这回水往新开的沟走了。

pairs.target: diànmù méi pào , chē guò de shíhòu yě búzài měng diān nà yíxià . "
pairs.english: The packing timbers didn't get soaked, and the carts don't give that hard jolt anymore.”
pairs.hanzi: 垫木没泡，车过的时候也不再猛颠那一下。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn gōu wā dào nǎér .
pairs.english: Tavi asked where the ditch went.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问沟挖到哪儿。

pairs.target: kù gōngyòng shī shǒuzhǐ zài ménkǎn wài huà le gè wān , shuō rào le duī liào dì ,
pairs.english: The worker drew a curve outside the threshold with a wet finger and said it went around the storage area.
pairs.hanzi: 库工用湿手指在门槛外画了个弯，说绕了堆料地，

pairs.target: jǐjiā gòngyòng yuànzi de yǐjīng shāngliáng hǎo , gè qīng zìjǐ nà yíduàn ,
pairs.english: The households sharing the yard had agreed that each would clear its own section.
pairs.hanzi: 几家共用院子的已经商量好，各清自己那一段，

pairs.target: gōukǒu hái dé xiàyǔ jiù qù kàn , shùyè yì duō zhàoyàng dǔ .
pairs.english: The ditch mouth still needed checking whenever it rained: too many leaves would block it just the same.
pairs.hanzi: 沟口还得下雨就去看，树叶一多照样堵。

pairs.target: zhǐ shàng nà jǐbǐ méi biànchéng yìtiáo zìjǐ huì gànhuó de gōu .
pairs.english: A few strokes on paper hadn't turned into a ditch that did its own work.
pairs.hanzi: 纸上那几笔没变成一条自己会干活的沟。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán xiào le , bǎ chēshàng de mùliào xièxià .
pairs.english: He laughed as he finished and unloaded the timber from his cart.
pairs.hanzi: 他说完笑了，把车上的木料卸下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bāng tā bǎ zuìhòu liǎnggēn táijìn gān chù , xiédǐ dài jìn yíchuàn nídiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi helped carry the last two lengths inside to a dry place, his soles leaving a trail of mud spots.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维帮他把最后两根抬进干处，鞋底带进一串泥点。

pairs.target: sòngzǒu rén yǐhòu , tā zhàn zài mén lǐ kàn le yíhuìer yǔshuǐ , cái tīngjiàn yǒurén zài bèihòu shuō bié dǔmén .
pairs.english: After seeing him off, Tavi stood just inside watching the rain for a while, until someone behind him said not to block the door.
pairs.hanzi: 送走人以后，他站在门里看了一会儿雨水，才听见有人在背后说别堵门。

pairs.target: nài lěi de pījiān dī zhe shuǐ , jiānshàng kángzhe yìzhī biǎn xiāng .
pairs.english: Nerai's cape dripped water, and a flat box rested on her shoulder.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾的披肩滴着水，肩上扛着一只扁箱。

pairs.target: tā xiān bǎ xiāngzǐ fàngxià , zài nǐng yījiǎo , nǐng chū de yìgǔ shuǐ bǐ tǎ wéi yǐwéi de duōdéduō .
pairs.english: She set the box down first, then wrung out the hem; far more water came out than Tavi had expected.
pairs.hanzi: 她先把箱子放下，再拧衣角，拧出的一股水比塔维以为的多得多。

pairs.target: " cóng běi chà huílái le ? "
pairs.english: “Back from Northfork?”
pairs.hanzi: “从北汊回来了？”

pairs.target: " cóng chénglǐ de huì wū . běi chà yàoshi zhème jìn , wǒ jiù bù chuān zhè shuāng xié le . "
pairs.english: “From the meeting house in town. If Northfork were that close, I wouldn't wear these shoes.”
pairs.hanzi: “从城里的会屋。北汊要是这么近，我就不穿这双鞋了。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ xié jiān lù gěi tā kàn , ní lǐ jiá zhe huì wū yuànzi tèyǒu de bái suìshí .
pairs.english: She showed him the toes: the mud held the white gravel peculiar to the meeting-house courtyard.
pairs.hanzi: 她把鞋尖露给他看，泥里夹着会屋院子特有的白碎石。

pairs.target: jīntiān yìzǎo chūqù , yuán shuō wǔqián néng huílái , jiéguǒ děng chuán zhàn de rén dào le cái sàn .
pairs.english: She had left early that morning, expecting to return before noon, but the meeting had only ended once the boat-station people arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 今天一早出去，原说午前能回来，结果等船站的人到了才散。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qù ná jiē shuǐ de pén , shùnshǒu bǎ huǒ biān de kōng dèng ràng chūlái .
pairs.english: Tavi fetched a basin for the drips and moved the empty stool by the fire into place for her.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维去拿接水的盆，顺手把火边的空凳让出来。

pairs.target: nài lěi méi zuò , xiān kāixiāng kàn bāo zài yóubù lǐ de tú .
pairs.english: Nerai did not sit; first she opened the box to check the maps wrapped in oilcloth.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没坐，先开箱看包在油布里的图。

pairs.target: zhǐ shì gān de , tā cái bǎ pījiān jiě xià , dā dào yǐbèi shàng .
pairs.english: Only when she saw the paper was dry did she undo her cape and drape it across the chair back.
pairs.hanzi: 纸是干的，她才把披肩解下，搭到椅背上。

pairs.target: tā shuōqǐ kù gōng gāng dàilái dehuà .
pairs.english: He told her what the warehouse worker had just said.
pairs.hanzi: 他说起库工刚带来的话。

alignment.english: what the warehouse worker had just said

pairs.target: tā tīng wán wèn nàtiáo gōu zuìhòu shìbushì rào le duī liào dì ,
pairs.english: After listening, she asked whether the ditch had ended up going around the storage area.
pairs.hanzi: 她听完问那条沟最后是不是绕了堆料地，

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō shì , biàn jiàn tā hū chū yìkǒuqì , shuō nàyàng jiù búyòng měicì xièhuò bǎ gōu tián huíqù .
pairs.english: Tavi said yes and saw her breathe out, saying that way they wouldn't fill the ditch back in every time they unloaded goods.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说是，便见她呼出一口气，说那样就不用每次卸货把沟填回去。

pairs.target: tā hē le bànbēi rèshuǐ , gàosù tā běi chà nàtiáo duǎnlù xiān qù chá .
pairs.english: She drank half a cup of hot water and told him the short Northfork route would be surveyed first.
pairs.hanzi: 她喝了半杯热水，告诉他北汊那条短路先去查。

pairs.target: zhī bō le yì xiǎoduì rén de xíngqī hé fèiyòng ,
pairs.english: Travel time and expenses had been allocated for only a small team,
pairs.hanzi: 只拨了一小队人的行期和费用，

pairs.target: dào le hébiān háiyào qǐng dāngdì rènlù de rén tóngháng .
pairs.english: and at the river they would still need local people who knew the way to accompany them.
pairs.hanzi: 到了河边还要请当地认路的人同行。

pairs.target: dōngtiān de huò bìng méiyǒu yīncǐ gǎi zǒu nàbiān , jiù rào lùshang de huòzhàn zhàocháng jiēhuò .
pairs.english: That did not mean the winter freight had been rerouted there; the stations on the old detour were receiving goods as usual.
pairs.hanzi: 冬天的货并没有因此改走那边，旧绕路上的货站照常接货。

pairs.target: " yīwén nà zhāng tú huì yòng ma ? "
pairs.english: “Will you use Iven's map?”
pairs.hanzi: “伊文那张图会用吗？”

pairs.target: " dàishàng de huì shì hé guò de nà yì bǎn . wǒ hái méinádào . "
pairs.english: “We'll take the checked version. I haven't received it yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “带上的会是核过的那一版。我还没拿到。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ wǎnfàn zhuōshàng zhēng guò de qiáomíng , wèn nà zuò qiáo zhǎo zhe méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Remembering the bridge names discussed at dinner, Tavi asked whether that bridge had been found.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起晚饭桌上争过的桥名，问那座桥找着没有。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō dìsāngè míngzì hái méi duì shàng dìfāng ,
pairs.english: Nerai said the third name still had not been matched to a place;
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说第三个名字还没对上地方，

pairs.target: shuí ruò dào le hébiān jiù àn zhǐ shàng de zì luànjiào , kǒngpà dé xiān bèi rén xiào yídùn .
pairs.english: anyone who reached the river and started calling places whatever was written on the paper would probably get laughed at first.
pairs.hanzi: 谁若到了河边就按纸上的字乱叫，恐怕得先被人笑一顿。

pairs.target: " nǐ yě huì bèi xiào ? "
pairs.english: “People laugh at you too?”
pairs.hanzi: “你也会被笑？”

pairs.target: " shàng huí bǎ rénjiā dōngtiān de shài wǎngjià rènchéng le lù lán .
pairs.english: “Last time I mistook someone's winter net-drying rack for a road barrier.
pairs.hanzi: “上回把人家冬天的晒网架认成了路栏。

pairs.target: nà háizi dào xiànzài jiàn wǒ , hái wèn yào buyào tì wǒ kāimén . "
pairs.english: That child still asks if I'd like him to open the gate whenever he sees me.”
pairs.hanzi: 那孩子到现在见我，还问要不要替我开门。”

pairs.target: tā jǔqǐ bēizi , zìjǐ xiān xiào qǐlái .
pairs.english: She raised her cup and began laughing first.
pairs.hanzi: 她举起杯子，自己先笑起来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě xiào , xiào wán cái fāxiàn tā de yòushǒu yìzhí ànzhe pījiān nèicè .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed too; only afterward did he notice she had kept her right hand against the inside of her cape.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也笑，笑完才发现她的右手一直按着披肩内侧。

pairs.target: guàshéng duàn le yíbàn , shībù de zhòngliàng quán tuō zài shèngxià jǐgēn xiàn shàng .
pairs.english: The hanging loop was half torn, and the weight of the wet cloth dragged on the few remaining threads.
pairs.hanzi: 挂绳断了一半，湿布的重量全拖在剩下几根线上。

pairs.target: tā wèn néng bunéng ná zhēn , tā diǎntóu , gàosù tā xiàn bāo zài xiāng gài nèi dài .
pairs.english: He asked if he could get a needle. She nodded and told him the sewing packet was in the pocket inside the lid.
pairs.hanzi: 他问能不能拿针，她点头，告诉他线包在箱盖内袋。

pairs.target: xiàn hěncū , tā zhǎo le liǎngcì zhēnyǎn cái chuān guòqù .
pairs.english: The thread was thick; it took him two tries to find the eye.
pairs.hanzi: 线很粗，他找了两次针眼才穿过去。

pairs.target: sè lā jiào tā de shōu biān zhēn bú shìhé zhèlǐ ,
pairs.english: The edging stitch Sela had taught him wasn't right here.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉教他的收边针不适合这里，

pairs.target: tā chāidiào tóu yìxiǎo duàn , gǎichéng láihuí rào zhù jiù kòuhuán .
pairs.english: He unpicked the first short section and instead wound back and forth around the old loop.
pairs.hanzi: 他拆掉头一小段，改成来回绕住旧扣环。

pairs.target: nài lěi zuòxià , tì tā tuō zhe shībù .
pairs.english: Nerai sat down and supported the wet fabric for him.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾坐下，替他托着湿布。

pairs.target: tā dītóu fèng , wèn chūmén de rén shìbushì dōu pàn zhe zǎodiǎn zǒu .
pairs.english: Sewing with his head bent, he asked whether people going away all hoped to leave as soon as possible.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头缝，问出门的人是不是都盼着早点走。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhèhuí yuánběn dāying yíwèi péngyǒu chīfàn , rìzi zhuàng shàng le .
pairs.english: She said this time she had promised a friend dinner, but the dates clashed.
pairs.hanzi: 她说这回原本答应一位朋友吃饭，日子撞上了。

pairs.target: nà péngyǒu huì bǎ hǎo cài chīdiào , zài liú zuì nán jiáo de yíkuài gěi tā , xiàhuí jiànmiàn háiyào tí .
pairs.english: The friend would eat all the good food, save the toughest piece for her, and mention it again the next time they met.
pairs.hanzi: 那朋友会把好菜吃掉，再留最难嚼的一块给她，下回见面还要提。

pairs.target: " nǐ bùxiǎng qù le ? "
pairs.english: “You don't want to go?”
pairs.hanzi: “你不想去了？”

pairs.target: " xiǎng qù . yě xiǎng chī nà dùnfàn . "
pairs.english: “I do. And I want that dinner.”
pairs.hanzi: “想去。也想吃那顿饭。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de zhēn tíng le tíng .
pairs.english: Tavi's needle paused.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的针停了停。

pairs.target: huǒ lǐ yíkuài xiǎo mùtou lièkāi , shēngyīn hěn cuì .
pairs.english: A small piece of wood split in the fire with a sharp crack.
pairs.hanzi: 火里一块小木头裂开，声音很脆。

pairs.target: tā hūrán xiǎng wèn zìjǐ zhǎngdà yǐhòu yào zěnyàng xuǎn ,
pairs.english: He suddenly wanted to ask how he should choose when he was older,
pairs.hanzi: 他忽然想问自己长大以后要怎样选，

pairs.target: yòu juéde zhè wèntí yì chūkǒu , jiù xiàng xiànzài yǐjīng yǒurén ná zhe xíngli děng tā .
pairs.english: then felt that saying it aloud would be like someone already waiting for him with packed bags.
pairs.hanzi: 又觉得这问题一出口，就像现在已经有人拿着行李等他。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhēn jìxù chuān guòqù .
pairs.english: He pushed the needle through again.
pairs.hanzi: 他把针继续穿过去。

pairs.target: nài lěi méi zhuīwèn , shēnshǒu bōkāi kuài pèngdào huǒpén de yījiǎo .
pairs.english: Nerai did not press him, but moved the hem that was getting close to the brazier.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没追问，伸手拨开快碰到火盆的衣角。

pairs.target: yǔshēng xiǎo le xiē , mǐlā cóng ménwài jìnlái , bào zhe nàgēn yòu wāi yòu duǎn de qiáoliáng .
pairs.english: The rain grew quieter. Mira came in from outside, carrying the short, crooked bridge beam.
pairs.hanzi: 雨声小了些，米拉从门外进来，抱着那根又歪又短的桥梁。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn tǎ wéi shǒulǐ de zhēn , shuō cè dǎng zài wǎnyìdiǎn yě xíng , fǎnzhèng qiáo jīntiān búhuì táo .
pairs.english: Seeing the needle in Tavi's hand, she said the side guide could wait a little longer; the bridge wasn't going to escape today.
pairs.hanzi: 她看见塔维手里的针，说侧挡再晚一点也行，反正桥今天不会逃。

alignment.english: the bridge wasn't going to escape

pairs.target: nài lěi wèn le liǎngjù móxíng de shì ,
pairs.english: Nerai asked a couple of questions about the model,
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾问了两句模型的事，

pairs.target: shuō tāmen míngtiān yào zài zhèlǐ zhěnglǐ cè lù qìjù , wéi lǎoshī huì dài jǐmíng xuéshēng lái bāngmáng ,
pairs.english: then said they would sort survey equipment here tomorrow; Instructor Vey would bring a few students to help.
pairs.hanzi: 说他们明天要在这里整理测路器具，维老师会带几名学生来帮忙，

pairs.target: tā hé tǎ wéi yuànyì dōu néng kànkàn , dàn dé tīng lǎoshī fēn huó .
pairs.english: She and Tavi could both take a look if they wanted, but had to follow the teacher's task assignments.
pairs.hanzi: 她和塔维愿意都能看看，但得听老师分活。

pairs.target: " qù běi chà ? " mǐlā wèn .
pairs.english: “To Northfork?” Mira asked.
pairs.hanzi: “去北汊？”米拉问。

pairs.target: " qù zhè zhāng zhuōzi pángbiān . "
pairs.english: “To the side of this table.”
pairs.hanzi: “去这张桌子旁边。”

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō zhè duàn lù tā rènde .
pairs.english: Mira said she knew the way for that stretch.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说这段路她认得。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zuìhòu yìzhēn shōu hǎo , jiǎndiào xiàntóu ,
pairs.english: Tavi secured the last stitch and cut off the thread end.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把最后一针收好，剪掉线头，

pairs.target: pījiān guà qǐlái yǐhòu méiyǒu zài wǎng xiàhuá .
pairs.english: When the cape was hung up, it no longer slipped down.
pairs.hanzi: 披肩挂起来以后没有再往下滑。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhēn sònghuí xiǎobāo ,
pairs.english: He returned the needle to the little packet,
pairs.hanzi: 他把针送回小包，

pairs.target: xiǎngdào míngtiān tóng yìzhāng zhuōshàng huì bǎi zhe yào qù hébiān de dōngxī ,
pairs.english: and thinking of the things bound for the river that would fill this same table tomorrow,
